text:
sophia: heads-up — invoice-preview jumped for tenant `alpha-corp` around 02:10 UTC after we rolled the new routing policy. looks like duplicated billing events flooding the preview pipeline. :confused:
tony: ugh. any quick repro? is it ingestion duplicates or downstream aggregation double-counting?
maya: I saw the preview spike on the dashboard too. rate went from ~120k tokens/hr to 360k for ~15m then back. no customer traffic increase.
ingest-bot: alert: duplicate_event_rate = 0.12 for shard-7 (5m window). suspected key change in dedupe set.
sophia: here's a sample of the event pair — same user request id but different route tag added after rollout. both made it through the fanout and into the invoice preview pipeline.
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_01G7X0Y2",
  "tenant": "alpha-corp",
  "route": "hosted-v2",
  "tokens": 450,
  "ts": "2026-03-17T02:10:12Z"
}
{
  "request_id": "req_01G7X0Y2",
  "tenant": "alpha-corp",
  "route": "dedicated-fallback",
  "tokens": 450,
  "ts": "2026-03-17T02:10:12Z"
}
```
aj: so we changed the dedupe key yesterday to include `route` to prevent cross-route dedupe. but that made perfectly identical logical requests look distinct when routed twice during rollouts.
tony: yeah that explains it — duplicate because of intentionally-different route metadata. how many tenants affected?
maya: quick query on the preview ledger shows ~1.1k duplicated request_ids across tenants in that 15m window. skewed to high-traffic customers.
aj: suggests two problems: 1) dedupe key choice was too strict, 2) preview pipeline doesn't detect same request_id collisions.
sophia: for immediate mitigation, can we revert dedupe-key to previous set (request_id + tenant) for preview path only? keep new key for final invoice path?
aj: we could. patch would be limited to the preview ingester; low risk. But long term we need a consistent idempotency story across fanout variants.
billing-bot: note: invoice-preview downstream caches may be invalid for affected buckets. previews for 2026-03-17 02:00-02:30 flagged.
ton y: (typo) tony: important UX impact — customers saw inflated preview and opened support tickets. ops signal is noisy.
maya: also a console UX quirk — the route breakdown chart shows both hosted & dedicated tokens attributed, making it look like traffic split when it didn't. confusing.
aj: plan proposal:
- short: revert preview dedupe key to (tenant, request_id). rollforward patch in 15m.
- medium: add a normalization step that canonicalizes events by stripping transient routing tags before dedupe in preview path.
- long: land an idempotency token at the edge (single source of truth) and propagate that through fanout.

aj: patch PR:```
--- a/preview-ingester/src/dedupe.rs
+++ b/preview-ingester/src/dedupe.rs
@@
- dedupe_key = format!("{}:{}:{}", tenant, request_id, route)
+ dedupe_key = format!("{}:{}", tenant, request_id)
```
sophia: will you own the rollback? assign to @aj and ping me after deploy. I'll draft a short support note so CS doesn't get surprised.
aj: on it. deploying to canary shard now. will monitor duplicate_event_rate and preview delta.
ingest-bot: deploy started: preview-ingester v1.12.3 -> canary-shard-3
ton y: we should also add a dashboard alarm for "route-tagged duplicates" so we catch this pattern earlier next time.
maya: Agreed. add a column in the preview table ui called `route_variants` to make the split obvious.
aj: quick metrics after canary deploy: duplicate_event_rate down to 0.01 in shard-3, preview token delta back to baseline.
sophia: nice. follow-ups:
- aj: roll to rest of clusters (after 30m monitoring)
- eng-platform: write short RFC for idempotency token design (edge -> ingestion -> billing)
- product: update console docs about route attribution (how routing affects preview vs final invoices)

maya: noted. I'll start the RFC draft and the console doc stub.

ajt: (typo) aj: will post rollback timeline and link to PR in this thread.
sophia: thanks everyone — good quick recovery. :thumbsup:
